ui_bugs.issue: Send button (`Send secure invitation`) is NOT disabled when the two consent boxes are unchecked, and clicking it while unchecked silently does nothing (no error toast / no inline error). Functionally the submit is blocked (URL stays on step 4), but users get no feedback about WHY. Preferred: disable button until both consent-authorised + consent-relationship are checked, or show an inline error.

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Disable the wizard Send button until both consent checkboxes are ticked, or surface a validation error on click so users understand why nothing happens.

No visible ObjectId leaks, all endpoints scoped by caller, integration key check on portal callbacks verified via backend tests.
